test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The average runs scored by a batsman in 23 matches is 42. In the next 10 matches, the batsman scored an average of 13 runs. Find his average runs scored (rounded off to two decimals) in all the 33 matches.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total runs in first group = 23 × 42 = 966

Total runs in second group = 10 × 13 = 130

Combined Average = (966 + 130) ÷ (23 + 10)

Average = 1096 ÷ 33 ≈ 33.21

**∴ The correct answer is 33.21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of matches (n₁) = 23, Average runs (A₁) = 42

Number of matches (n₂) = 10, Average runs (A₂) = 13

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36ace8fc27b6591891f469a496e94bafa7f4c2bd214acb454e8c0b2a24eba81e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total runs in 23 matches = 23 × 42 = 966

⇒ Total runs in 10 matches = 10 × 13 = 130

⇒ Total matches = 23 + 10 = 33

⇒ Total runs in 33 matches = 966 + 130 = 1096

⇒ New Average = 1096 ÷ 33

⇒ New Average = 33.2121...

⇒ New Average ≈ 33.21

**∴ The correct answer is 33.21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

It is used when finding the average of a combined group where sub-groups have different sizes. Formula: (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...).

Sum of Observations

The total sum of all values is always equal to Average × Total number of items.

Rounding to Two Decimals

When rounding to two decimals, examine the third decimal digit; if it is 5 or greater, add 1 to the second decimal digit.</p
